text: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for joining the planning meeting for the spring course.
Morning. I had a look at the syllabus draft last night, and I think the first two weeks are too crowded.
That's fair. What would you move?
I would push the probability unit back by a week, so students have time with proofs first.
I agree with that. The lab sections also need an extra session on recursion before the first exam.
Okay. Tara, can you draft the lab schedule, and Daniel, can you revise the reading list?
Yes, I can have the schedule ready by Friday.
And I will send the reading list on Monday.
Great. Let's meet again next week to review both.
